Default.note: Relaxed, centered below the sloping neckline.

Guard.note: Compact chest; the bent guarding hand can cover the pendant.

Special.note: Prayer: naturally behind the joined hands, not moved outside them for visibility.

Slash.note: Narrow, turned chest; slight leftward slant along the sweep.

Penetrate.note: Forward lunge; chain follows the diagonal chest without touching the tucked fist.

Hit.note: Short V-shaped chain, clear of the fist below.

Evade.note: Folded torso: diagonal chest fit with the near palm in front.

Damaged.note: Recoil: asymmetric chain curves and tilted small cross follow the raised chest.

Move.note: Running left: small rightward trailing slant, kept inside the garment.
